Other notable papers include SimCLR from February 2020, which introduced a simplified framework for contrastive learning, and the development of TriSCOPE in Nature for identifying gene programs specific to individual brain cell types in Alzheimer’s disease. Additionally, Morgan Stanley's research includes a provably convergent Schrödinger Bridge model for time series imputation and a manifold view of adversarial risk.
